description: AEP canalisations is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CALN (agglomération Lisieux-Normandie). Couche linéaire représentant le réseau d'eau potable de l'agglomération Lisieux-Normandie. Coverage: Lisieux-Normandie agglomeration (Normandy, France). The publisher credit on the ArcGIS item is CALN (Lisieux-Normandie agglomeration). Its keywords include opendata, geospatial, eau. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, KML, WEB PAGE, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
